references.text: This verse contains the original instruction from God to Moses to make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle, as Exodus 36:28 describes their execution.
These verses provide further details about the corner boards and their construction in the original instructions for the tabernacle.
The preceding verse describes the six boards made for the back of the tabernacle toward the west, to which the corner boards in verse 28 were attached.
These verses continue the description of the corner boards' construction and their bases, complementing the information in verse 28.
The connection between the command for six boards and the execution of two (corner-placed) boards clarifies the technical solution for the corners of the west wall.
The link between the instruction for the crossbars at the back and the execution of the actual boards in the same place shows the complete structural plan.
